title: Product Manager
description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\*\***

We are looking for a **Product Manager** who embraces an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), using AI throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and deliver measurable customer outcomes. You will use AIDLC to lead the strategy and execution of capabilities across our Product Experience Management (PXM) platform while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance customer productivity at scale.

**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**

* Define functional and non-functional requirements and recommend solutions in the form of POCs, prototypes, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to groom stories and iterate on prototypes throughout the release cycle.
* Act as a proxy for the business throughout development, testing, and release activities to ensure business needs are met.
* Develop business analysis artifacts, such as business rules and process flows, to clarify requirements.
* Coordinate with other departments in advance of feature and product launches to develop messaging that supports and promotes new releases, features, and updates.
* Conduct product training internally and externally, including training internal trainers, developing new product and feature documentation, and introducing new functionality to internal employees and key customers.
* Provide consistency and clarity to development projects by identifying business needs and constraints, defining scope, and ensuring efficient execution.
* Design product processes that move initiatives forward using AI tooling.
* Advance the use of AI and autonomous agents to transform and accelerate the product development lifecycle.

**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**

* 4–5 years of Product Management experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS products.
* Proven experience operating within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), leveraging AI across discovery, requirements, design, delivery, and product optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of defining, launching, and scaling AI-powered features, agents, automation workflows, or intelligent recommendation systems.
* Hands-on experience using Generative AI and LLM-based tools to accelerate product management workflows, improve decision-making, and increase team productivity.
* Strong understanding of AI product patterns, including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Ability to identify high-value automation opportunities and translate them into measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Data-driven mindset with experience defining success metrics, evaluating AI outcomes, and driving continuous product improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, implementation-ready product requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.
* Experience in PIM, PXM, DAM, Syndication, eCommerce, Retail, CPG, Manufacturing, or Distribution domains (preferred but not required).

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**
---------------------------------

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

**Position Description**

**Product Manager – AI & Digital Solutions**

**Role Overview**
=================

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle—from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement—for one or more solutions within CDW’s Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
===============================

**Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

**Solution Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

**Solution Development & Delivery**

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

**AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

**Working Model**
=================

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education and/or Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Digital Workplace
* Infrastructure Modernization

Experience with:

* Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

**Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**
=========================================

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

*The information in this position description is intended to convey information about the key responsibilities and requirements of the position. **The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Looking for Product Lead who will own the technology-driven product lifecycle of the personal loan offering from system architecture and platform capability to launch, performance monitoring, and continuous optimisation. **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the technology roadmap for the personal loan product who drive enhancements to the Loan Origination System (LOS), Loan Management System (LMS), CRM, and customer-facing digital journeys (app/web).
* Partner with the Technology/IT/Engineering HOD to define system architecture, API integrations (credit bureaus, KYC/Aadhaar e-sign, payment gateways, UPI AutoPay/NACH), and platform scalability requirements.
* Translate business and credit requirements into detailed functional/technical specifications (BRDs/PRDs/user stories) for developers and QA teams and own UAT sign-off before releases. Drive automation and digitisation of the loan journey from onboarding, KYC, credit decisioning, e-sign, disbursal, and repayment to reduce manual intervention and improve TAT.
* Collaborate with the Credit & Risk HOD to translate underwriting policy and scoring logic into system rules and automated decision engines.
* Work with the Compliance & Legal HOD to ensure all product workflows, data handling, and system processes meet RBI/NBFC regulatory and data-security requirements.
* Align with the Sales & Business HOD on product positioning, ticket-size/tenure structures, and channel-specific journey requirements (DSA, digital, in-house).
* Partner with the Marketing HOD on data requirements for campaign targeting, lead scoring, and conversion-funnel tracking.
* Own product analytics and reporting infrastructure from set up dashboards (Power BI/SQL) to track approval rate, disbursement TAT, drop-off points, portfolio yield, and system uptime.
* Benchmark competitor personal loan platforms (fintechs, NBFCs, banks) on technology and journey experience and recommend product/tech differentiation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Strong, hands-on understanding of digital lending technology architecture — LOS/LMS platforms, API integrations, credit bureau pulls, e-KYC/e-sign, payment/NACH systems.
* Ability to write and review BRDs/PRDs, work with Agile/Scrum delivery teams, and manage release cycles alongside Engineering.
* Solid grasp of personal loan/unsecured lending products, credit underwriting logic, and NBFC operations.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with SQL/Power BI/Excel to interpret system and portfolio data for product decisions.

Responsibilities:

**Position Purpose:**

StoneX is modernising client onboarding and setup across the firm. This multi-year programme will replace fragmented and duplicated processes with a controlled, scalable capability spanning due diligence and KYC/AML through account creation, entitlements, credit and risk setup, reference data and trading readiness.

The Onboarding Product Management team bridges the technical and business worlds, working closely with Engineering, Business Analysis, Compliance/AML and other business functions to deliver this capability. As an Associate Product Manager, you will lead analysis within defined onboarding workstreams, work with stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, and help translate agreed changes into product and delivery outcomes. This may include exploring how automation and AI could streamline onboarding processes.

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn product management, work with stakeholders across regions and business lines, and influence how the onboarding experience is delivered.

**Primary duties will include:**

* Leading the analysis of current-state onboarding processes within assigned workstreams, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, control and client experience.
* Engaging stakeholders across regions and business lines to gather input, validate findings and support recommendations.
* Collecting and analysing feedback, product analytics and market insights to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
* Working with large data sets to identify volumes, bottlenecks and trends across onboarding processes.
* Translating product ideas into clear requirements and deliverables.
* Partnering with senior Product Managers to shape onboarding product strategy and roadmap.
* Supporting the design of the end-to-end client experience across applicable systems.
* Acting as an onboarding solutions and KYC processes subject-matter expert, representing the onboarding team internally and externally.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a field related to business, technology, or client solutions.
* Experience in business analysis, process analysis or product management, ideally within financial services (experience in KYC/AML, compliance, or onboarding is a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to assess processes, identify inefficiencies and propose practical improvements.
* Comfort working with large data sets to identify trends and support evidence-based recommendations.
* Experience using, or willingness to use, AI tools to support analysis and assessment work.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies, backlog management, and product delivery practices.

**What makes you stand out:**

* A relevant accreditation in Business Analysis.
* Knowledge of client onboarding and setup, including KYC/AML, client due diligence, account and entity creation, entitlements, credit and risk.
* Exposure or experience working on onboarding transformation projects across multiple regions and legal entities.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills, with the ability to drive decisions without direct authority.

**Working environment:**

* In-office – 4 days a week.
* Some travel may be required to support stakeholder engagement across regions.

About GravityONE

**GravityONE** is an AI-native technology company building the next generation of products for strategy, decision-making and execution. We work at the intersection of **AI, strategy, data and enterprise workflows**, helping organisations move beyond traditional dashboards and disconnected tools towards intelligent systems that can help leaders and teams plan, decide, coordinate and act.

Our products are designed for complex environments where strategy needs to translate into measurable outcomes—with the right context, governance, intelligence and accountability built into the way organisations operate.

One of our core products, **StrategyDotZero**, is building an AI-native strategy-execution platform for governments and enterprises. We help executives, Strategy Offices, PMOs and transformation teams connect strategy, planning, performance, portfolios and delivery into one intelligence-enabled operating environment.

Our ambition is to move beyond dashboards and workflow tools—to create governed digital experts and agentic workflows that help organisations plan, decide, coordinate and act with greater confidence.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptional, hands-on **Product Manager** to turn this vision into a focused, market-ready product.

You will sit at the intersection of **strategy, design, data, analytics and AI**: shaping product direction, rapidly testing concepts with customers, and working closely with engineering, AI and growth teams to turn complex problems into elegant, adoptable capabilities.

This is a build-stage role for someone who enjoys ambiguity, moves quickly and can balance bold product thinking with disciplined execution. We are particularly interested in candidates who bring the **structured problem-solving and transformation mindset of top-tier consulting**, combined with strong product judgement and the ability to build and ship.

What you will do

* Translate the StrategyDotZero vision into clear product strategy, customer journeys, MVPs, roadmaps and fortnightly release plans.

* Run agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, release readiness and post-release learning with discipline and pace.
* Partner with growth and customer teams to shape demos, value narratives, pilots, customer feedback loops and product-market fit.

* **5+ years of experience** in product management, product design, strategy/technology consulting or a related product-building role.
* **MBA from a reputed institution**, preferably with a focus on strategy, technology, operations or a related discipline.
* **Prior experience with a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG) or a strong strategy/management consulting environment is highly preferred.** We value candidates who have developed strong structured problem-solving, executive communication, business transformation and stakeholder management skills and can apply that thinking to product development.
* Experience building **B2B, enterprise SaaS, workflow, analytics, data or AI-enabled products**—ideally in complex, regulated or multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong understanding of strategy execution, planning, PMO, portfolio management, transformation, performance or operational governance; deep expertise in every domain is not required, but curiosity and rapid learning are.
* Practical familiarity with AI product patterns: **LLMs, RAG, structured outputs, agentic workflows, enterprise data context, human-in-the-loop design, evaluation and feedback loops.**
* Strong UX and design judgement, with the ability to use tools such as **Figma and AI-assisted prototyping tools** to make concepts tangible quickly.
* Comfortable working with data, dashboards, integrations, APIs and enterprise workflow concepts; able to speak credibly with engineers without needing to be a full-time developer.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to move comfortably between a **client executive, product designer, engineer and delivery practitioner.**
* A strong bias toward action: able to frame a problem, form a hypothesis, prototype, test, learn and improve within days—not months.
* Comfortable in a lean, high-growth environment where ownership is broad, priorities evolve and quality still matters.

What success looks like

* A focused, differentiated product roadmap that converts the StrategyDotZero vision into commercially valuable releases.
* Fast, evidence-led product discovery with customers and a regular cadence of validated prototypes and shipped capabilities.
* Clear and reusable product patterns for enterprise AI: governed agents, source-grounded outputs, human approvals and actionable workflows.
* Strong alignment between product, engineering, AI, growth and client teams.
* A platform that customers experience not as another PMO tool, but as an **intelligence layer that improves the quality and speed of strategy execution.**
* A product leader who brings together **consulting rigour, product thinking, AI fluency and execution discipline** to turn complex enterprise problems into simple, valuable products.

If you think this

If you think this role is for you, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
### **Who We Are**

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

**Who we are**

Simpplr builds AI-powered intranet for modern enterprises. Our platform unifies employee engagement, enablement, and services, leveraging state-of-the-art AI models to deliver a seamless, cohesive, and personalized employee experience for everyone — wherever and however they work.

Our mission is to transform the work experience for billions of people across the world. Because we believe that when work is good, life is better.™

Trusted by more than 1,000 leading brands, including DocuSign, Penske, Splunk, Nutanix, Okta, Eurostar, and SoFi, our customers are achieving measurable improvements in employee engagement, productivity, and accelerated business performance.

Simpplr is headquartered in Silicon Valley, CA with offices in the UK, Canada, and India, and is backed by Sapphire Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and Tola Capital. Learn more at simpplr.com.

  

**The role**

We have more ideas than we can build. Your job is to figure out which ones are real, and turn the survivors into a product specification sharp enough for engineering to build from.

You won't be generating ideas!! You'll be the person who decides which ones deserve investment — through live customer conversations, rigorous market sizing, and a written case that leadership can act on. Some of what you look at should die. Killing an idea well is as valuable here as championing one !!

**What you'll do**

* Take a rough concept and design the fastest honest test of whether there's a real need behind it
* Run customer and prospect interviews; separate what people said from what you concluded
* Size the opportunity — TAM/SAM, pricing, unit economics — and be clear about which assumptions the number actually rests on
* Write the recommendation memo: build, don't build, or build something narrower. Own the call.
* Turn a validated concept into a PRD — problem, scope, what's in the first version and what isn't
* Work with engineering leads on feasibility early enough that it changes the spec, not after

**What we're looking for**

* MBA from IIM A/B/C/L/I/K or equivalent.
* Exceptional structured writing. Your memos are the product of this role.
* High Comfort with numbers: financial modeling in Excel/Sheets, basic SQL, product analytics
* Can hold a real conversation with a senior Global executive based in developed markets (or a frustrated customer without a script !!)
* Already using AI tools in how you work, not just aware of them

**What you get**

Direct access to CXOs on a daily basis, real ownership of investment recommendations, and a short path between your analysis and what actually gets built.

### **Your Voice, Unfiltered:**

We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview

Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!

If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

### **Simpplr’s Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model:**

At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.

* **Hub -** **100% work from Simpplr office.** Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time.
* **Hybrid -** **Hybrid work from home and office.** Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* **Remote - 100% remote.** Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

**﻿Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

**Fun Stuff**

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.

* Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.
* Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.
* Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.
* Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

**2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.
* Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.

**3. Roadmap & Prioritization**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.
* Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.
* Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.
* Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.

**4. Requirements Management**

* Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.
* Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.
* Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.
* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.

* Define launch, enablement, and adoption strategies; execute go-to-market plans with Marketing and Sales.
* Drive onboarding, customer training, and customer success initiatives.
* Track adoption, usage, engagement, retention, and revenue performance.
* Identify adoption barriers, act on post-release feedback, and improve value realization.

**6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership**

* Act as the primary point of contact for product decisions across internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate consensus and decision-making across diverse groups.
* Report roadmap progress, product performance, risks, and opportunities; influence strategy with data-driven recommendations.

**7. Performance & Analytics**

* Define and track product KPIs and success metrics.
* Measure adoption, retention, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and ROI.
* Maintain executive dashboards and lead periodic product performance reviews.

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, or Computer Science; or an MBA with specialization in Product Management.

**Job Description:**

**About the Team-**

It is a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems.

The USP of the team is people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have.

Some examples of the digital solutions for various Core Engineering departments such as Data driven designs of wiring, automated routing electrical harnesses, Data Analytics based product aimed at reducing physical tests of material specimens. It also involve developing web-based solutions to encapsulate and automate different workflows such flight test planning etc. In addition to these points, developing tools for Electrical Wiring Harness and Hydraulic Circuit design process improvements. Some of the tools developed; are used in the areas of Aircraft Safety analysis and Engineering Business Data monitoring etc.

M&T is also deeply involved in Agile Scrum and SAFe in developing state of the art digital products for the areas mentioned above.

About the Role-

We are looking for a Product Owner who comes from a software development background. You will own the team backlog for an Agile team operating within an Agile Release Train (ART), and you will do it as someone who has written production code, sat through releases, and understands what a story actually costs to build.

This is deliberately a technical Product Owner role. We are not looking for a pure business analyst or a scrum administrator. We want someone who can sit with engineers, read the design, challenge an estimate on its merits, and still hold a credible conversation with stakeholders about value and priority.

You will be the voice of the customer inside the team and the single point of decision on what gets built next.

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**What you'll do-**

  

Own the team backlog

  

* Create, refine and prioritise the team backlog so there is always at least two iterations of ready work

* Break features handed down from Product Management into user stories and technical enablers with clear acceptance criteria

* Sequence work based on value, dependencies, technical risk and capacity and be able to explain the sequence to anyone who asks

* Make informed calls on technical debt and enabler work, because you understand what it buys the team Drive the SAFe cadence

* Represent the team at PI Planning: contribute to planning objectives, negotiate scope, surface and resolve dependencies with other teams on the train

* Run backlog refinement and participate in Iteration Planning, Iteration Review, System Demo and Inspect & Adapt

* Work alongside the Scrum Master / Team Coach, Product Management, the RTE and the System Architect to keep the team aligned with ART priorities Accept the work

* Be the sole accepter of stories against defined acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done

* Validate what was built against what was intended, including non-functional requirements performance, security, maintainability

* Provide fast, unambiguous answers to the team during the iteration; unblocking is a core part of the job, not an interruption Represent the customer and the stakeholders

* Gather input from users, business stakeholders and support/operations, and translate it into backlog items

* Keep stakeholders informed on progress, trade-offs and changes no surprises at the demo

* Software development life cycle: a solid, practical understanding of the full SDLC requirements, design,

development, testing, release and maintenance and how decisions early in the cycle play out later

jQuery, Ext JS or Node.js

familiarity

months

description:
Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.

The Growth & Product Team

Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

* The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.

* Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

* The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.

* The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

* The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For

* Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.

* Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.

* Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

* Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.

* Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.

* Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.

* Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.

* Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.

* Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

The role will help bring together customer needs, data, design, technology, and AI to create experiences that make complex measurement easier to explore and use.

You will own product work from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work with product, engineering, design, and client-facing teams. The ideal candidate is a self-starter. You create structure in ambiguous situations. You move initiatives forward. You make practical decisions based on customer needs, business value, data, and technical feasibility.

* Define product direction for assigned areas in alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Translate customer, market, and commercial insights into clear product opportunities; partner with Design and Engineering to shape scalable solutions.
* Own the roadmap and backlog, making prioritization and trade-off decisions; develop product requirements, and prototypes.
* Lead initiatives through discovery, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Use research customer feedback to guide decisions; build alignment across the organization to move these decisions forward through influence.
* Ensure product experiences are consistent across user interfaces, APIs, and other delivery channels.
* Define product goals, KPIs, and adoption measures, and use them to evaluate impact.
* Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify workflows and improve customer outcomes.
* Shape connected AI product experiences that bring together related data and insights to help users answer broader business questions.
* Contribute to a strong product culture by sharing knowledge, supporting teams, and raising the quality of product thinking.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of experience in product management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred; a Master’s degree is a plus.
* Experience in SaaS, DaaS, analytics, data products, or enterprise software.
* Experience taking complex initiatives from concept through launch and adoption, guiding collaborative teams and influencing without formal authority.
* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to understand data models, data flows, metrics, and measurement methodologies.
* Modern AI aptitude, including familiarity with model evaluation, prompt design, MCP, and agentic workflows.

* Experience in ad tech, audience measurement, or media analytics is preferred.
* Ability to explain complex topics to technical, commercial, executive, and customer audiences.
* Self-directed, organized, and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous situations.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**About Upstox**

Upstox is building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and accessible to everyone. As one of India's fastest-growing fintech platforms, Upstox is backed by leading global investors, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global. Our mission is to enable wealth creation for every Indian, serving millions of users ranging from first-time investors to experienced traders. We operate at speed, with purpose, and in an environment that values impact, ownership, and innovation.

  

**The Role: Growth Product Manager – F&O**

Futures & Options is one of the most active trading segments at Upstox, and this role sits right where F&O trader behavior meets business outcomes. As Growth Product Manager – F&O, you'll drive business growth and customer engagement across the F&O product, owning initiatives focused on activation, reactivation, revenue and ARPAU improvement.

You'll work closely with the Product Manager and business stakeholders to spot growth opportunities and translate business problems into clear, well-structured requirements. Your core ownership is business requirements, growth opportunities, F&O metrics, funnel optimization and business impact — documented through BRDs rather than PRDs. Your interaction with Design and Engineering will be relatively limited and largely routed through the Product Manager, with Business, Analytics/Data and other cross-functional teams as your day-to-day partners.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**F&O Growth & Business Metrics**

* Drive initiatives that improve key F&O growth metrics — activations, reactivations, engagement and ARPAU
* Identify opportunities across the customer journey that can positively impact revenue and business performance
* Analyze business and customer data to uncover growth opportunities, funnel gaps and areas of improvement
* Work with relevant stakeholders to define success metrics and measure business impact

**Business Requirements & Product Collaboration**

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to identify and prioritize business opportunities
* Translate business problems, customer insights and growth opportunities into detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Clearly articulate the business objective, customer problem, requirements, use cases, expected outcomes and success metrics
* Work with the Product Manager to ensure business requirements translate effectively into product initiatives
* Participate in discussions around feature prioritization and business impact

**New Product & Feature Initiatives**

* Identify and propose new features or enhancements based on customer needs, market opportunities and business objectives
* Develop BRDs for new initiatives and work with the Product Manager through the product development lifecycle
* Support feature launches by defining business objectives, target users, adoption metrics and go-to-market requirements
* Track post-launch performance and recommend improvements to drive adoption and business impact

**Funnel & Growth Optimization**

* Analyze existing F&O customer funnels to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Drive initiatives to improve activation, reactivation, conversion, feature adoption and engagement
* Evaluate existing product features and customer journeys to find opportunities for optimization
* Use data and experimentation insights to recommend changes that improve business outcomes

**F&O Domain Expertise**

* Bring a strong understanding of Futures & Options trading and trader behavior
* Understand key F&O customer journeys, use cases and pain points
* Monitor market and industry trends to identify relevant growth and product opportunities
* Translate F&O business and customer needs into actionable product requirements

**How Success Is Measured**

This role is closely tied to measurable business outcomes: F&O activation, reactivation, ARPAU, revenue impact, funnel conversion, feature adoption, customer engagement and the performance of the growth initiatives you drive.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Experience:** 3–7 years in Product Management, Growth, Business/Product Strategy, Fintech or a similar role
* **F&O exposure:** Hands-on experience with, or strong exposure to, F&O trading products
* **Commercial sense:** A strong understanding of business metrics, revenue levers and growth metrics
* **Growth track record:** Experience working on initiatives involving activation, reactivation, ARPAU, conversion or revenue improvement
* **BRD craft:** Experience creating Business Requirement Documents and translating business problems into clear requirements
* **Product partnership:** Understanding of the product development lifecycle and experience working closely with Product Managers
* **Analytical rigour:** Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities through data
* **Stakeholder management:** Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across Business, Product and Analytics
* **Ownership:** The ability to work independently and drive business initiatives from problem identification through implementation and measurement

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You'll own growth for F&O, one of the most active and revenue-critical segments on one of India's fastest-growing trading platforms.
* Your work is tied directly to outcomes that matter — activation, reactivation, ARPAU and revenue - so your impact is visible and measurable.
* You'll shape what gets built, turning trader insight and data into BRDs that become real product initiatives.
* You'll work alongside sharp Product, Business and Analytics teams who move fast and care about doing it right.
* Every initiative you drive will shape how millions of Indian traders experience the markets.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

title: Senior Product Manager, AI
description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will serve as a Senior Product Manager for Teradata's vector search and unstructured data capabilities, driving product vision, strategy, roadmap, execution, and adoption. You will define how enterprises turn documents, images, audio, and other unstructured content into searchable, trusted context that AI applications and agents can retrieve at scale, alongside the structured data they already manage in Teradata.

On the retrieval side, you will own the product direction for vector and hybrid search: indexing and approximate nearest neighbor techniques, filtering, ranking and re-ranking, and the balance between recall, latency, freshness, and cost. You will work with engineering to make vector search a first-class, SQL-native capability that performs at enterprise scale and concurrency, and you will define how relevance and quality are measured, not only how fast queries run.

On the ingestion side, you will own how unstructured data gets into the platform: connectors to object stores and enterprise content sources, document parsing, OCR, chunking, metadata extraction, embedding generation, and incremental refresh. You will shape pipelines that are reliable, governed, and cost-efficient, with access controls, lineage, and sensitive-data handling that carry through from source to retrieved result.

Your impact will be measured by customers moving from retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) prototypes to production AI applications and agents that run on trusted enterprise data, with measurable gains in answer quality, time to value, and cost per query.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will collaborate with customers, engineering, the database engine and SQL teams, AI platform and data science teams, cloud infrastructure, UX, governance and security, product marketing, and field teams to bring next-generation retrieval capabilities into Teradata's enterprise ecosystem. You will be responsible for ensuring our products meet business objectives.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized institution. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

* 6+ years of experience in software product development companies, including 3+ years in product management working with AI/ML, search, or data platform products.

* Strong knowledge of embeddings and vector search, including index types (such as HNSW and IVF), quantization, filtered and hybrid search (keyword plus vector), and re-ranking.

* Working understanding of RAG, LLMs, and AI agents, and how retrieval quality drives answer quality. Experience defining evaluation metrics such as recall, precision, and relevance.

* Understanding of unstructured data ingestion: document parsing, OCR, chunking strategies, multimodal content, metadata extraction, and embedding pipelines, including GPU considerations.

* Experience with data pipelines and connectors on cloud object storage, including batch and incremental or streaming ingestion.

* Experience with APIs, SDKs, and integrations for enterprise and developer adoption, including open ecosystems such as Python, Jupyter, and agent frameworks.

* Familiarity with the competitive landscape, such as Pinecone, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, pgvector, Snowflake, Databricks, and MongoDB, and the ability to benchmark against it.

* Excellent communication skills, with a strong track record of customer engagement, product KPIs, and prioritization.

* Experience with AI productivity tools, and the ability to work independently and deliver high quality outcomes in fast-paced environments.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience building search, retrieval, or data ingestion products at scale, with a clear view of the trade-offs between recall, latency, freshness, and cost.

* Hands-on exposure to building RAG applications or agents on structured and unstructured enterprise data.

* A quality mindset: the discipline to build benchmarks and evaluation sets, and to let data decide between approaches.

* A strong understanding of responsible AI, including explainability, auditability, and protection of sensitive data in retrieval.

* Vision to anticipate how agents will use retrieval, and to position Teradata's offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

* Passion for intuitive developer and user experiences, such as natural language search and simple, SQL-friendly interfaces.

* Ability to influence engineering and go-to-market teams without direct authority, and to mentor others.

description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.  
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.

* Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
* Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
* Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.

description:
**About the Company**

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

**Role Summary**

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
* Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
* Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
* Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
* Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
* Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
* Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
* Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
* Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

**Requirements (Must-Haves)**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
* Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
* Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
* Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
* Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
* Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
* Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
* Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
* Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
* Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

  
**Benefits**  
  
Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1.

You will own one significant part of our product estate end to end: strategy, requirements, delivery and adoption. You will also be kAIgentic’s experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries.

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Define the UX vision that maximizes adoption and quantifiable value across the kAIgentic product suite.
* Architect integrated experience roadmaps that reconcile enterprise governance, legacy workflows, and AI capabilities into seamless user journeys.
* Influence senior leadership, customers, and engineering partners to align feature priorities with reduced cognitive load and heightened trust.
* Represent kAIgentic in customer workshops and industry panels, extracting tacit knowledge that refines the product experience.
* Define measurable adoption and impact metrics, linking user behavior to business outcomes and informing iterative improvement.
* Architect the translation of market, regulatory, and workflow insights into clear product briefs and decision criteria.
* Influence the adoption of AI-enhanced design and research tools within product teams, accelerating evidence-based iteration.

### **Own your product area**

* Set strategy, roadmap and requirements. Write the specs engineering builds from, and make the scope calls, including what to cut.
* Run discovery with the people who do the work. These are experts in banking operations, risk and compliance, often in Japan, and often in situations where you cannot observe the work directly.
* Define success measures that tie user behaviour to outcomes and quality, such as effort per confirmed process, rework and review quality, not adoption alone.

### **Lead experience across the platform**

* Set the experience principles and interaction patterns all products follow. These cover how the product shows confidence and uncertainty, when it asks a person for input, and how review and approval work. Hold the bar in design reviews.
* Own the journeys that cross products, so that what a user confirms in one carries cleanly into the next.
* Design human review that auditors and regulators would accept as meaningful, not a rubber stamp, and define how we measure that it is.
* Design for mixed audiences in the same flow: experts who use the product once or twice, and analysts who work in it daily.
* Prototype with AI tools quickly enough to test ideas with users in days, and raise the team’s practice to match.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* Proven expertise delivering UX-focused product strategy for large-enterprise AI solutions, with a track record of driving adoption and measurable value
* Mastery of product discovery and delivery frameworks, including hypothesis-driven research, PRD authoring, and iterative validation.
* Deep knowledge of enterprise workflow analysis, governance models, compliance constraints, and integration patterns.
* Expertise in AI research fundamentals and the ability to translate model capabilities into user-centric features.
* Strong capability in designing and evaluating user experiences that reduce cognitive load, clarify intent, and build trust.
* Skilled at synthesizing market, regulatory, and customer insights into concise product briefs and strategic direction.
* Exceptional judgment in balancing technical feasibility, security, and scalability with user value.
* Clear, persuasive communication with senior stakeholders, engineering, and customers, both in writing and presentations.
* A track record of owning both a product and its experience in enterprise software used for complex, high-stakes work.
* Judgment to separate essential complexity from accidental complexity. You can show where you removed work and where you deliberately kept it.
* Experience designing oversight of AI or automated decisions, including how model uncertainty and failure reach the user.
* Strong skill at eliciting knowledge from domain experts. Experience in a regulated industry, with banking preferred.
* Hands-on prototyping, including fluency with AI design and prototyping tools. AI-native velocity as a default mode of working
* Clear writing: specs, decision briefs and principles that others can apply without you in the room.
* Influence without authority across product managers, engineering and global stakeholders. Experience with Japanese enterprise clients is a plus.

**Why join kAIgentic?**

We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.

We look for people who:

* Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.
* Are entrepreneurial and energized by zero-to-one problems with no playbook.
* Lead with ownership, integrity, and collaboration, not titles.
* Want to help define a new category of enterprise AI, not just ship inside an existing one.
* Working here means being surrounded by peers who challenge assumptions, celebrate progress, and build with both courage and care.

**Life at kAIgentic**

* Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.
* Innovation at enterprise scale. Startup velocity meets the depth, scale, and stakes of mission-critical, regulated environments. Both are non-negotiable.
* Ownership from Day One. Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the outcomes our customers see.
